service.description: Executes a single pipeline compute step. Records an AgiPipelineStep in PlsExecuting status, triggers the AI agent dispatch, writes the output into AgiPayload, and updates egressPayloadId upon completion. Auto-compiles astTree to rawXmlContent for Build steps.
Creates an unexecuted draft step branching off or succeeding an existing step. Supports advancing from Plan -> Build with targetStanceEnumId. egressPayloadId is explicitly left null.

actions.script:
ec.logger.info("🔱 [fork#PipelineStep] Processing fork/advance from source step #${sourceStepId}...")
def srcStep = ec.entity.find("org.moqui.ai.pipeline.AgiPipelineStep") .condition("pipelineStepId", sourceStepId) .one() if (!srcStep) { ec.logger.error("❌ [fork#PipelineStep] Source step #${sourceStepId} not found!") ec.message.addError("Source Step ${sourceStepId} not found") return }
String discId = srcStep.discussionId
String rawStance = targetStanceEnumId ?: stanceEnumId ?: srcStep.stanceEnumId String effectiveStance = "AamPlan" if (rawStance in ["AamBuild", "build"]) effectiveStance = "AamBuild" else if (rawStance in ["AamDiscuss", "discuss"]) effectiveStance = "AamDiscuss" else if (rawStance in ["AamPlan", "plan"]) effectiveStance = "AamPlan"
String activeIngressId = ingressPayloadId ?: (srcStep.egressPayloadId ?: srcStep.ingressPayloadId)
if (modifiedPayloadJson && modifiedPayloadJson.trim()) { ec.logger.info("📋 [fork#PipelineStep] Storing modified payload JSON as new ingress AgiPayload...") def srcPayload = activeIngressId ? ec.entity.find("org.moqui.ai.payload.AgiPayload") .condition("agiPayloadId", activeIngressId) .one() : null
def clonedPayload = ec.entity.makeValue("org.moqui.ai.payload.AgiPayload") clonedPayload.modeEnumId = effectiveStance clonedPayload.statusId = "PlsDraft" clonedPayload.targetComponent = srcPayload?.targetComponent ?: "nursinghome" clonedPayload.artifactUri = srcStep.targetArtifactUri clonedPayload.discussionId = discId clonedPayload.title = "Ingress for Step successor to #${sourceStepId}" clonedPayload.userPromptText = directivePrompt ?: srcStep.directivePrompt clonedPayload.payloadJsonData = modifiedPayloadJson.trim() clonedPayload.parentPayloadId = activeIngressId clonedPayload.createdDate = ec.user.nowTimestamp clonedPayload.setSequencedIdPrimary() clonedPayload.create()
activeIngressId = clonedPayload.agiPayloadId ec.logger.info("📋 [fork#PipelineStep] Created cloned ingress AgiPayload #${clonedPayload.agiPayloadId}") }
int branchSeq = ((srcStep.stepSequenceNum as Integer) ?: 1) + 1 String defaultPrompt = directivePrompt ?: (effectiveStance == "AamBuild" ? "Generate canonical Moqui XML screen and UI artifacts from Plan #${sourceStepId}" : srcStep.directivePrompt)
def forkedStep = ec.entity.makeValue("org.moqui.ai.pipeline.AgiPipelineStep") forkedStep.discussionId = discId forkedStep.parentStepId = sourceStepId forkedStep.stepSequenceNum = branchSeq forkedStep.stanceEnumId = effectiveStance forkedStep.statusId = "PlsDraft" forkedStep.stepLabel = (effectiveStance == "AamBuild" ? "Build from #" : "Branch from #") + sourceStepId forkedStep.ingressPayloadId = activeIngressId forkedStep.directivePrompt = defaultPrompt forkedStep.egressPayloadId = null // Unexecuted forkedStep.targetArtifactUri = srcStep.targetArtifactUri forkedStep.createdDate = ec.user.nowTimestamp forkedStep.setSequencedIdPrimary() forkedStep.create()
context.newStepId = forkedStep.pipelineStepId context.ingressPayloadId = activeIngressId context.statusId = "PlsDraft"
ec.logger.info("🔱 [fork#PipelineStep] Successfully created draft successor Step #${forkedStep.pipelineStepId} [Stance: ${effectiveStance}, Parent: #${sourceStepId}, Ingress: #${activeIngressId}]")

service.description: Recursively flags an AgiPipelineStep and all downstream descendant steps as PlsArchived.

actions.script:
ec.logger.info("📦 [archive#PipelineBranch] Archiving branch starting from step #${pipelineStepId}...") int count = 0
def archiveStepRecursive archiveStepRecursive = { String stepId -> def step = ec.entity.find("org.moqui.ai.pipeline.AgiPipelineStep") .condition("pipelineStepId", stepId) .one() if (step && step.statusId != "PlsArchived") { step.statusId = "PlsArchived" step.lastUpdatedDate = ec.user.nowTimestamp step.update() count++ ec.logger.info(" - Archived step #${stepId}")
def children = ec.entity.find("org.moqui.ai.pipeline.AgiPipelineStep") .condition("parentStepId", stepId) .list() children.each { child -> archiveStepRecursive(child.pipelineStepId as String) } } }
archiveStepRecursive(pipelineStepId) context.archivedCount = count ec.logger.info("📦 [archive#PipelineBranch] Completed archival of ${count} step(s).")

service.description: Decomposes an approved module scope into individual draft PLAN steps. Iterates through a list of sub-modules/sub-screens and forks a downstream draft step for each, anchored to the parent discussion step.
